articles.title: Djokovic Wins in Beijing for First Victory Since Wimbledon
articles.summary: Novak Djokovic beat Nuno Borges 6-3, 7-6 (7-2) at the China Open. It was his first win since the Wimbledon semi-finals in July and his 30th straight win in Beijing. He took a medical timeout for his right shoulder.

articles.title: This 3.1-Mile Table Is Made From Recycled Materials!
articles.summary: About 20,000 people sat down to eat at one very long table in Bucharest, Romania. The 3.1-mile table was made from recycled materials and set a Guinness World Record. The event raised more than $110,000.

articles.title: NASA Wants to Build a Base on the Moon
articles.summary: NASA has announced a $20 billion plan to build a permanent Moon base near the south pole. Robots go first, starting in 2026. A permanent outpost phase begins in 2032, with a nuclear power plant planned for the long lunar nights.
